title: Baby Registry Concierge & Virtual Baby Proofing | The Village Parent Community
body:
The Village Every Parent Deserves

I know how overwhelming parenthood can feel, because I've lived it. 




Whether you need help building your perfect registry, 

making your home safe for your growing family, 

or just an extra set of hands during one of life's most demanding seasons.




 I offer personalized virtual and 

in home support for parents at every stage of the journey. 

Wherever you are, whatever you need, I've got you.

Virtual Baby Registry & Baby Proofing Support for Parents
LEARN MORE ABOUT REGISTRY CONCIERGE SERVICE
LEARN MORE ABOUT VIRTUAL BABY PROOFING SERVICE
VIEW OUR IN HOME SERVICES
HOW MY VIRTUAL SERVICES WORK
Step 1

Get Started




Registry concierge begins with a free 15 minute consultation so I can get to know you before we dive in. 

Virtual baby proofing packages are booked and paid directly.




Just pick your package, answer a few quick questions, and we're off!

Step 2

I Get to Work




 For registry concierge I learn everything about your life and build your perfect registry from scratch. 




For virtual baby proofing you send me photos and I do a thorough room by room review.

Step 3

I've Got You After 




Whether it's registry updates until your shower day or follow up questions about your safety plan, I don't disappear when the work is done.




I'm here.

LEARN MORE ABOUT REGISTRY CONCIERGE SERVICE
LEARN MORE ABOUT VIRTUAL BABY PROOFING SERVICE
Hi, I'm Brynn,

Owner of The Village Parent Community and the

woman behind it's Parent Services.




This is me in all my glory — pumps on, PJs on,

baby monitor in hand.




I’m a little quirky, a little overstimulated, and I have

no filter.




I might look like an absolute hot mess on the

outside.




But beneath that first layer is an immense amount

of empathy, care, and devotion to the parents in

my life.




I have a mission to change the way support works

for parents in my community.




I provide these services personally, with insured

care, thoughtful boundaries, and deep respect for

your home and family.




I'm a mom of three, Ive built hundreds of registries, and I know exactly what you need and what's a waste of money!




Learn more about me and why I started The

Village Parent Community.

ABOUT ME
Need In Home Support?

Sometimes you just need an extra set of hands.

Whether you're nesting before baby arrives, recovering after your shower, or just need someone to show up and help, The Village offers in home parent support services for families in Northwest Indiana and the Chicagoland area.




VIEW IN HOME SERVICES
HOW MY IN HOME SERVICES WORK
Step 1

Send me an email so we can talk through what you need and find the right service for your situation.

Or you can book immediately if you know what you need!

Brynn@thevillageparentcommunity.com

Step 2

Every family is different. 

We'll figure out exactly what would make your life feel lighter and build a plan around that.

Step 3

I come to you, ready to help!

 No judgment, no unrealistic expectations, just real hands on support when you need it most.

The Village is here for every overwhelming moment. 

Please reach out if you have any questions

brynn@thevillageparentcommunity.com
